shortDescription: LG delivers the ultra-large, 27 cu. ft. capacity of a standard-depth fridge packaged in a counter-depth design for a sleek, built-in look. Stock up on everything you need and enjoy more space for your family's favorite foods and drinks.

features.text: Make Ice Without Making Ice
LG's built-in icemaker automatically makes ice cubes, so that you always have ice on hand for those hot summer days or when entertaining at home.
Smart Cooling, Smarter Living

LG's intelligent Smart Inverter Compressor adjusts cooling power based on the amount of food stored and the refrigerator's inside and outside temperature. LG confidently backs the Inverter Compressor with a 10-year limited warranty.
Consistent Temps from Top to Bottom

Located in the top of the fresh food section, the Door Cooling + vent extends the reach of LG’s Smart Cooling system. Blasts of cool air reach all areas of the refrigerator including the door to help maintain consistent temperatures from top to bottom and help keep all foods fresh and flavorful.
Premium Style, Easy Opening

MAX out your fit with LG's hybrid handle design for easy opening and premium style. LG's new bar handle design is slightly contoured to comfortably fit your hand. Discreet pocket handle on the freezer drawer makes it easy to slide it open, even when fully loaded. Together, they create a sleek look that complements the flat panel design.
Sharp Design and Sleek Fit
Enjoy a built-in look with the counter depth feature on this LG refrigerator. Thanks to its slightly shallower depth, it can stand flush with your countertop for a sleek look.
The Look You Love(With the Fuss)

Now you can have all of the things you love about stainless, without the need for special cleaners or constant attention.  LG’s PrintProof™ finish resists fingerprints and smudges for a distinctive kitchen that handles real-life in style.
Cool Guard Interior
Cool Guard metal interior panel wall helps maintain cold air while adding a premium look.
Run Your Home Like a Pro

The LG ThinQ® app helps you manage all of your LG smart appliances and more, all to make your everyday a little easier. Automatically reorder supplies based on actual usage. Start or stop programs on your way home from work. Access thousands of recipes and get help meal planning with ingredients you already have in your fridge. Even get proactive alerts with ThinQ Care to keep your appliances running smoothly and your home running smarter.
More Organization. Easier Access.

The 2 crisper drawers gives you easy access to your fruits, vegetables and beverages. This refrigerator also features a full-width Glide N' Serve® drawer, making the it easy to find some space for all that food you want to keep fresh.
Access Fresh Filtered Water Single Handedly
Easily access fresh filtered water with the internal water dispenser. Conveniently fill your cup, pitcher or even a small sauce pot.
